metadata.purpose: Prioritized defect and evidence-gap register for the DigiTracks replacement audit.

severityVocabulary.P1: Release blocker or material security, integrity, governance, discoverability or conversion failure.
severityVocabulary.P2: Material quality, SEO, accessibility, performance or operability issue to fix before launch.
severityVocabulary.P3: Lower-priority hardening, documentation or reconciliation item.

sourceNotes: fresh_verified records were checked by local read-only source or public read-only HTTP/source during the 2026-11-25 audit.
prior_observed records preserve the supplied baseline. Their original observation date was not supplied; recordedAt is 2026-11-25 and originalObservedAt remains UNKNOWN.
No form was submitted and no state-changing request was made.
A defect is not proof of WCAG, Lighthouse, mobile or field-performance conformance; those measurements remain separate evidence gaps.

defects.title: HCM Fusion assessment answers and rationales are exposed before submission
defects.owner: HCM Fusion owner and assessment owner

evidence.detail: Serialized RSC payload contains key, isCorrect, rationale and correctOrder. Twelve isCorrect occurrences were found in the inspected four-question payload.

defects.impact: Learners can obtain answer keys and scoring rationale before submitting; the published claim that answers are marked after submission is not upheld by the delivered payload.
defects.recommendation: Keep answer keys, correctness and scoring rationale server-side until submission. Return only the minimum result view after a validated attempt and test every assessment family.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: No pre-submission response, client bundle, RSC payload or client state contains answer keys, correct ordering, correctness flags or answer rationales; scoring tests pass for valid, invalid and replayed attempts.

defects.title: HCM Fusion robots policy conflicts with indexable evidence and user routes
defects.owner: HCM Fusion owner and SEO owner

evidence.detail: Disallows /admin, /api/, /login, /profile, /progress, /learn/saved, /analytics and /evidence/.
371 public /evidence/claims/<ID> links.
200 with robots index, follow; /progress and other user routes show the same conflict.

defects.impact: Search engines receive contradictory signals. Evidence pages are publicly linked but disallowed, while private/user routes advertise indexability.
defects.recommendation: Approve a route-level indexability matrix with the owner. Align robots, meta robots, canonicals, authentication and sitemap membership; do not automatically index the current unsitemapped surface.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Every route has one intentional policy; public evidence is either crawlable and sitemapped or deliberately excluded; private/user/admin/API routes are non-indexable and protected as appropriate.

defects.title: SourceCraft indexes 122 terms that remain in editorial review

evidence.detail: 122 occurrences of status in_review; inspected reviewedAt values are null.
All 122 term pages are sitemap members and emit index, follow.

defects.impact: Unreviewed editorial content is publicly discoverable and can be mistaken for approved guidance.
defects.recommendation: Require editorial approval and a real reviewed date before indexing or migration. Otherwise emit deliberate noindex and exclude from sitemaps while preserving preview access if needed.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: No in_review term is indexable or sitemapped; approved records have reviewer, reviewed date, substantive update date and source/permission metadata.

defects.title: Rights-reserved SourceCraft and HCM Fusion content has no migration permission
defects.owner: Digi Tracks owner and editorial/legal approver

evidence.detail: Term text, editorial notes and regional notes are all rights reserved; no reuse grant.
Public crawlability is not redistribution permission; HCM lessons, concepts, glossary, evidence, assessments, procedures, scenarios and diagrams require permission.

defects.impact: Content cannot be lawfully copied into the replacement on the available evidence.
defects.recommendation: Obtain written permission and editorial approval with scope, attribution, update rights and permitted derivatives. Independently author content where permission is not granted.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: A signed/recorded permission covers every migrated content family and asset; provenance records link each item to that permission.

defects.title: Authorized application source and state/scoring schemas are missing

evidence.detail: Canonical content, assessment scoring, scenario branches, progress schemas, migrations, authentication/roles, tenant boundaries, exports and deployment configuration are required owner inputs.

defects.impact: Authenticated behavior, scoring, saved work and tenant isolation cannot be reproduced faithfully or safely from public HTML alone.
defects.recommendation: Obtain authorized source/data and migration fixtures. Keep blocked features explicitly unavailable rather than shipping simulated production behavior.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Owner-supplied repositories/data are reviewed; schema and role contracts are documented; migrations and parity tests pass against approved fixtures.

defects.title: No estate visual asset is proven approved for reuse

evidence.detail: 100 records; 85 unknown provenance, nine generated placeholders, two font candidates, one prohibited font and three licence texts. Zero approved visual assets.

defects.impact: Logos, screenshots, photos, icons and social cards could be reused without ownership or licence evidence; generated wordmarks could be mistaken for approved identities.
defects.recommendation: Record owner, licence/permission, source hash, approval date and permitted use for each asset. Replace placeholders only with approved marks or clearly labelled original typographic treatments.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Every shipped visual asset has an approved allowlist record and matching source/destination hash; no unknown or generated-placeholder asset is presented as verified product identity.

defects.title: Portal lead flow lacks durable received, retry and CRM-webhook semantics

evidence.detail: Direct email delivery from /api/send-email and /api/lead; no D1/outbox/queue/webhook implementation.
Forms send to the studio inbox.

defects.impact: A visitor can be told a message was received without durable storage, retry, dead-letter handling or proven CRM delivery.
defects.recommendation: Implement the approved D1/outbox/queue flow with stable idempotency, bounded retries and signed CRM webhook. Return received only after durable write and distinguish received from delivered.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Staging proves inbox and webhook receipt, idempotency, signature rejection, timeout/retry, permanent failure and dead-letter handling without PII in analytics.

defects.title: HCM Fusion serves pages without a Content Security Policy

evidence.detail: No content-security-policy header.

defects.impact: The application lacks a browser-enforced mitigation for script injection and unintended external resource loads.
defects.recommendation: Generate a tested CSP from one source, using nonces/hashes where required and explicit connect/script/frame/worker allowances.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: All document routes emit an enforced CSP; no console/runtime regressions; strict-mode tests reject unexpected origins and inline execution.

defects.title: ProcureSherpa serves its application without a Content Security Policy

evidence.detail: No content-security-policy header.

defects.impact: A large inline/local-first application has no CSP containment for script or resource injection.
defects.recommendation: Define a CSP compatible with the local-first architecture and test file/hosted modes without weakening the policy unnecessarily.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: CSP is present and enforced on hosted documents; application, calculator, export and offline behaviors pass under the policy.

defects.title: LearnPMO CSP permits broad external connections and inline styles

evidence.detail: connect-src allows https: and wss:; style-src allows unsafe-inline; image/font sources also allow broad https:.

defects.impact: The nonce-based script policy is weakened by permissive resource and connection directives.
defects.recommendation: Allowlist required origins and remove broad network/style permissions where feasible. Keep nonce-based script handling.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: CSP contains no unjustified wildcard external origins; optional cloud sync fails closed when its endpoint is not allowlisted.

defects.title: LearnPMO unknown routes return an indexable application shell

evidence.detail: 200 application shell with robots index, follow.
200 application shell; /api/ redirects to /api.

defects.impact: Arbitrary invalid paths can be indexed as soft 404s, diluting crawl quality and confusing users.
defects.recommendation: Use a route manifest and return a real static 404 for unknown public paths. Reserve API namespaces for API behavior, not HTML shells.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Unknown paths return 404 with useful navigation and noindex; valid workspace routes retain their intended status and state behavior.

defects.title: HCM Fusion configuration-order content says seven steps but enumerates six actions

evidence.detail: Seven setup steps wording; six actions: legal entity, business unit, department, location, worker time entry profile and assignment.
Repeats the seven-step wording.

defects.impact: Learners receive a contradictory prerequisite count in lesson, objectives and exports.
defects.recommendation: Choose an owner-approved model that clearly distinguishes six configuration actions from decision/terminal nodes, then update all derivatives from one source.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Lesson, objectives, long descriptions and all export formats agree on action, decision and terminal-node counts.

defects.title: HCM Fusion catalogue and coverage counts are stale or differently scoped

evidence.detail: States 12 modules, 47 of 156 lessons, five published modules, four in production and three planned.
Nine course pages; three additional courses return 200 but are unsitemapped.
States 446 claims/441 verified/five gaps; only 371 evidence pages are publicly linked.

defects.impact: Users cannot tell which counts describe planned, published, public or verified material.
defects.recommendation: Derive all counts from approved registries and label scope explicitly: planned, published, public, sitemapped, reviewed and migration-cleared.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: No hard-coded derived count can drift; course, source and sitemap views reconcile or explain intentional scope differences.

defects.title: HCM Fusion Markdown exports claim 53 diagrams but the set contains 51
defects.owner: HCM Fusion content and export owners

evidence.detail: All 27 exports returned 200. HTML figures, Markdown Diagram headings and text Diagram headings each total 51 across nine modules.
States 53 diagrams while Absence contains 22.

defects.impact: Every Markdown module export carries a stale estate-wide count, undermining export trust.
defects.recommendation: Generate per-module and total diagram counts from the content registry; add format parity tests.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Each export reports its actual diagram/figure count; HTML, Markdown and text totals agree; no hard-coded 53 remains without evidence.

defects.title: SourceCraft trailing-slash aliases return duplicate 200 documents

evidence.detail: /terms/batna also returns 200 with identical bytes; both canonicalize to the slash form without redirecting.
/explore and /explore/ both return 200; /regions/IN behaves similarly.
Alias and slash form both return 200.

defects.impact: Duplicate URL forms create avoidable crawl and analytics ambiguity.
defects.recommendation: Choose one trailing-slash policy and issue one-hop 308 redirects for aliases while preserving deep-link mappings.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Only canonical forms return 200; aliases redirect once to the same-origin canonical; no loops or chains.

defects.title: SourceCraft Explore and Twitter metadata are generic

evidence.detail: og:title and og:url use homepage values; og:image and Twitter image use /og/default.png.
All 139 pages have social images, but the inspected system uses generic/default artwork rather than page-specific evidence.

defects.impact: Shared previews do not distinguish terms, regions or utility intent.
defects.recommendation: Generate unique titles/descriptions and approved 1200x630 social cards from verified brand assets or original technical diagrams.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Every indexable template has useful unique metadata and a reachable approved social image; utility routes are deliberately noindex where appropriate.

defects.title: SourceCraft manifest icon dimensions do not match the files

evidence.detail: Declares /icons/icon-192.png as 192x192 and /icons/icon-512.png as 512x512.
Actual 192x175.
Actual 512x465; maskable 512 icon is 512x512.

defects.impact: Install surfaces can crop, scale or reject icons inconsistently.
defects.recommendation: Ship approved true-square 192, 512 and maskable assets with safe-area padding; derive manifest entries from measured dimensions.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Manifest dimensions equal actual files; install/update tests pass on supported browsers and the artwork has clearance evidence.

defects.title: SourceCraft emits no JSON-LD across 139 sitemap pages

evidence.detail: Zero JSON-LD blocks across 139 pages.

defects.impact: Term and regional content lacks eligible structured signals for search discovery.
defects.recommendation: Add DefinedTerm and appropriate Article/BreadcrumbList data only for approved content and verified facts.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Schema validates, matches visible content, contains no unsupported ratings/prices/reviews and is emitted only on eligible approved routes.

defects.title: HCM Fusion lacks JSON-LD and social images on all 168 sitemap pages
defects.owner: HCM Fusion SEO and brand owners

evidence.detail: 0 JSON-LD blocks; 168 pages lack OG/Twitter images; canonical and one H1 are present on all 168.

defects.impact: Rich reading, course and evidence surfaces have weak preview and structured-data coverage.
defects.recommendation: Prioritize approved Course, Article and BreadcrumbList schema plus unique social cards; do not invent instructor credentials, ratings or outcomes.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Eligible approved templates emit validated same-origin metadata/schema and approved social cards; private routes remain excluded.

defects.title: LearnPMO lacks JSON-LD and social images on all 12 sitemap pages

evidence.detail: 0 JSON-LD blocks; all 12 pages lack OG/Twitter images; canonical and one H1 are present.

defects.impact: Public application/workspace pages have limited preview and structured-data coverage, and their indexing intent itself needs review.
defects.recommendation: Approve which workspace pages are public-seo versus utility/private, then generate metadata only for intentional public pages.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Each of the 12 routes has an explicit indexability decision, unique metadata where public, and approved social imagery where eligible.

defects.title: ProcureSherpa initial shell has no H1 and no social image

evidence.detail: 200; canonical and one JSON-LD block present; zero H1 elements in initial HTML; no OG/Twitter image.

defects.impact: The only sitemap URL lacks a server-rendered primary heading and social preview image; client-only content may also be unavailable to non-JavaScript crawlers.
defects.recommendation: Server-render a meaningful H1 and public shell content, add approved social imagery, and document the client-route indexing strategy.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Initial HTML contains one descriptive H1 and approved OG/Twitter image; hash-route discoverability is explicitly designed and tested rather than assumed.

defects.title: ProcureSherpa ships an approximately 1 MB HTML shell and 2.92 MB content script

evidence.detail: 1,007,173-byte HTML response in the audit capture.
Approximately 2.92 MB JavaScript.

defects.impact: Initial transfer and parse costs are likely high, especially on mobile; actual LCP/INP/CLS remain unmeasured.
defects.recommendation: Separate static shell/content data, route-level code splitting, compression and caching; defer nonessential tools while preserving local-first/offline behavior.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Representative mobile lab and field budgets are measured and met; no regression in offline, hash deep links, calculator behavior or exports.

defects.title: Portal business identity and customer proof are incomplete

evidence.detail: Country empty; founder/legal entity/city/phone/owned social profile unset; TESTIMONIALS empty.

defects.impact: Visitors cannot verify who operates the studio or substantiate product outcomes, weakening quote and demo conversion.
defects.recommendation: Obtain approved business identity and genuine proof. Until supplied, state only verified contact details and omit unsupported testimonials/logos/case studies.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Published identity details have owner evidence; every testimonial/logo/case study has permission and source; absent proof is not fabricated.

defects.title: HCM Fusion public reading pages use private no-store caching

evidence.detail: Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate on public pages.

defects.impact: Public lessons and evidence cannot benefit from shared caching, increasing repeat transfer and origin load.
defects.recommendation: Define per-template cache policy: public immutable content can use validated shared caching; authenticated/user responses remain private/no-store.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Public content caches safely with invalidation on substantive updates; private progress/notes/bookmarks never enter shared caches.

defects.title: HCM Fusion duplicate/slow unauthenticated API calls remain unquantified
defects.originalObservedAt: UNKNOWN — prior baseline supplied without an original date

evidence.detail: Duplicate/slow unauthenticated API calls reported; no fresh browser network/timing trace was captured in this read-only phase.
Public chunks reference /api/bookmarks, /api/notes, /api/progress/lesson and /api/auth/sign-out; this does not by itself prove duplication.

defects.impact: Potential duplicate requests and slow unauthenticated calls may waste bandwidth and delay interactive views, but magnitude is UNKNOWN.
defects.recommendation: Capture a read-only browser network/timing trace per template, deduplicate shared requests, add caching/abort behavior where safe and measure before/after.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Request counts, timing and payload sizes are documented per template; no duplicate critical calls remain; authenticated boundaries are preserved.

defects.title: Three valid HCM Fusion course pages are indexable but absent from the sitemap
defects.owner: HCM Fusion content and SEO owners

evidence.detail: 200, self-canonical, index, follow, not in sitemap.
200, self-canonical, index, follow, not in sitemap.
200, self-canonical, index, follow, not in sitemap.

defects.impact: Valid public courses have conflicting discovery signals and complicate the 12-module/9-course reconciliation.
defects.recommendation: After editorial approval, either include them in the sitemap with correct coverage metadata or deliberately noindex them; do not leave accidental mismatches.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Every valid indexable course is sitemapped; every omitted course has an explicit policy and rationale.

defects.title: LearnPMO manifest and favicon URLs return HTML

evidence.detail: 200 text/html, not a manifest.
200 text/html.
200 text/html.

defects.impact: Install metadata and browser icon discovery are broken or ambiguous; the HTML fallback can also be indexed.
defects.recommendation: Serve correct MIME types and approved assets, or return a deliberate 404 for unsupported aliases. Add utility-route tests.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Manifest JSON parses, icons match declared dimensions, favicon is a valid image, and HTML utility fallbacks are noindex or absent.

defects.title: Previously reported SourceCraft /favourites/ 404 no longer reproduces

evidence.detail: 200; noindex, follow; canonical /favourites/.
Earlier report said the route was broken/404.

defects.impact: Repeating the old defect would create false audit noise; browser persistence behavior still requires functional testing.
defects.recommendation: Retain the current 200/noindex behavior as the baseline and test saved-state migration rather than recreating the old 404.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Route stays successful; slash policy is normalized; favourites state migration and offline behavior are tested with fixtures.

defects.title: Non-indexable stats origin returns HTTP 520
defects.impact: The origin is unavailable but is outside the approved six-host public replacement scope.
defects.recommendation: Keep it excluded from public navigation/sitemaps; document the owner decision if observability is later brought into scope.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Replacement scope remains six hosts; no link or sitemap entry presents stats as a public product.

defects.title: Search Console, IndexNow and analytics verification are unknown
defects.originalObservedAt: UNKNOWN — prior baseline supplied without an original date

evidence.detail: Search Console acceptance and property verification were not supplied.

defects.impact: Indexing acceptance, coverage errors and analytics operation cannot be reported as complete.
defects.recommendation: Obtain owner access or operator evidence; document submission/verification as owner actions with dates and screenshots/exports where permitted.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Each origin has a verified property or an explicit UNKNOWN/owner-action record; no local script claims external acceptance.

defects.title: Accessibility, Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals and mobile conformance are unmeasured

evidence.detail: Static HTML/source/header inspection only; no axe, manual keyboard/screen-reader, device matrix, Lighthouse or field-data run.

defects.impact: The audit cannot substantiate WCAG 2.2 AA, responsive behavior or performance targets.
defects.recommendation: Run automated and manual accessibility testing plus representative lab and field performance measurement in the implementation QA phase.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: QA report includes device/browser matrix, axe results, manual keyboard/focus/screen-reader/zoom/reflow/reduced-motion checks and measured LCP/INP/CLS/Lighthouse with limitations.

defects.title: ProcureSherpa reuses three content IDs across different type namespaces

evidence.detail: make-or-buy, framework-agreement and supplier-financial-risk each occur as both kb and dec. Typed routes are unique, so the correct total is 506 rather than 503.

defects.impact: Code or registries that assume globally unique IDs can resolve relationships or saved state incorrectly even though typed URLs remain distinct.
defects.recommendation: Use composite content keys (type, id) and preserve the existing typed URL mappings; validate uniqueness at the composite-key level.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: All content, relations, saved state and exports use type-aware keys; tests reject accidental cross-type collisions.

defects.title: Portal route, prerender and metadata definitions are duplicated and documentation has drifted
defects.originalObservedAt: UNKNOWN — prior baseline supplied without an original date

evidence.detail: Duplicated runtime/prerender/metadata route definitions and historical documentation drift reported.
Approved plan identifies this as a reference for generated metadata/sitemap/header principles, not a runtime dependency.

defects.impact: Manual synchronization increases the risk of stale counts, route omissions and inconsistent metadata.
defects.recommendation: Drive routes, sitemaps, redirects, metadata, schema and tests from one typed registry; derive counts rather than duplicating them.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Build/tests reject duplicate routes, missing content, cross-origin canonicals, unsupported claims and stale derived counts.

defects.title: Portal rate limiting is not proven enforceable and bot verification was inactive

evidence.detail: Documents non-enforcing Cloudflare Rate Limiting binding; compensating per-isolate memory limit, optional Turnstile and owner-managed WAF rule.
Live CSP has no Turnstile host, consistent with bot verification being off.

defects.impact: Public lead endpoints may have weaker abuse controls than the architecture requires; WAF enforcement is unverified.
defects.recommendation: Configure fail-closed bot verification for production and prove approximate rate limiting at the edge/API boundary. Document WAF ownership and tests without exposing secrets.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Staging proves valid/invalid Turnstile, rate-limit behavior, origin/method/schema/size rejection and safe error responses; production WAF evidence is owner-recorded.

defects.title: HCM Fusion lacks COOP/CORP isolation headers

evidence.detail: No Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy or Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy observed.

defects.impact: The origin misses useful cross-origin isolation hardening, particularly around authenticated/user features.
defects.recommendation: Add owner-approved COOP/CORP values and test popup, export and authentication behavior.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Headers are consistent across document/API/asset routes and do not break required cross-origin flows.

defects.title: LearnPMO HSTS does not declare preload

evidence.detail: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains, without preload.

defects.impact: Transport policy is weaker and less consistent than the other five origins, though HSTS is present.
defects.recommendation: Align HSTS after confirming all subdomains are HTTPS-ready; preload only after owner approval and validation.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: HSTS policy is documented and consistent; no HTTP or broken subdomain remains before preload consideration.

defects.title: SourceCraft favourites/recents storage keys were not fully confirmed
defects.originalObservedAt: UNKNOWN — prior baseline supplied without an original date

evidence.detail: Plan names source-craft:favourites:v1 and source-craft:recent:v1 for migration.
Inspected chunks confirmed source-craft:explore-url, source-craft:region and source-craft:region:v1, but not the two named state keys.

defects.impact: A migration could reset or misread saved terms/recents if the actual schema differs from the plan.
defects.recommendation: Obtain authorized state schema and fixtures; inspect real browser storage read-only where permitted; version and test migrations without silent reset.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Every preserved key and value shape has a documented fixture; migration tests prove no data loss and clear handling of corrupt state.

defects.title: Estate deployment and origin-state boundaries span two platforms

evidence.detail: Cloudflare serves portal/Learn; Vercel serves the four application hosts.

defects.impact: Header, cache, CSP, deployment and incident behavior can drift across origins; cookies/localStorage must remain origin-bound.
defects.recommendation: Generate shared security/SEO policy from one source while keeping per-origin deployment adapters, state namespaces and manifests explicit.
defects.acceptanceCriteria: Automated estate tests assert per-origin headers, canonicals, sitemaps, manifests and state isolation; no runtime dependency crosses back to the reference repository.
